newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala Corp consolidates BPI stake.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Corp consolidates BPI stake.

text.p: Philippine conglomerate Ayala Corp is consolidating its direct control of Bank of the Philippine Islands (BPI) by buying shares from its subsidiaries, underwriter BPI Capital Corp said on Tuesday.
BPI Capital said Ayala had signed a private placement agreement with Ayalafil Inc, BPI Capital Corp and BPI Securities Corp at 125 pesos per share.

Ayalafil would be selling 5,835,659 BPI shares, while both BPI Capital Corp and BPI Securities would be selling 31,768,762 BPI shares through a block sale within 60 days, the company told the Philippine Stock Exchange.
The sale would boost Ayala's direct equity in BPI to 52.09 percent from the present 46 percent.
The BPI was trading at 146 pesos in late Tuesday trade, up 2.0 pesos from the previous close.
